job:
AI Engineer

Vortex Intelligence is seeking an experienced AI Engineer to build and maintain production systems that integrate large language models with retrieval and search capabilities. You'll own the full lifecycle of RAG services, from data pipeline to user-facing quality metrics.

Must-have:
- 3+ years of production Python development
- Shipped at least one production service at scale
- Hands-on experience building or working with RAG systems, retrieval pipelines, or semantic search
- Experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks for model quality assessment
- Proficiency with Docker and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)

Nice-to-have:
- Experience with observability platforms (DataDog, New Relic, Jaeger)
- Vector database knowledge (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate)
- Background implementing LLM cost tracking and optimization
- Experience with reranking or learning-to-rank approaches

You'll work with our Platform team to enhance our evaluation infrastructure, optimize retrieval quality, and ensure our systems remain reliable and cost-effective. Remote-friendly role with flexible hours.
